description: Land Title Settlement Department - Halmillawa, Mahasenpura Thissamaharama D/S Division, Hambantota District.
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific land parcel numbers, cadastral map references, ownership details, and declarations regarding land titles in specific locations. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes), and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
